headline: President Asif Ali Zardari and Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif met in Islamabad on Thursday and agreed that all matters should be resolved through dialogue, a Presidency statement said, Dawn reports.

card.desc: Leaders met in Islamabad, Presidency statement says

caption:
President Zardari and PM Shehbaz agree to resolve all matters through dialogue! 🤝
According to Dawn, President Asif Ali Zardari and Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif met in Islamabad on Thursday, with Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi also present. A Presidency statement said the two leaders agreed that all matters should be resolved through dialogue and consultation. They reviewed the country's political situation and also discussed the Middle East conflict.
